description: This file defines the SBC (Subband Codec) class for Bluetooth A2DP audio codec implementation, including nested classes for configuration and format specifications, as well as methods for configuration, encoding, decoding, and serialization.

classes.name: SBC
classes.description: Represents the SBC Bluetooth audio codec, including configuration, format, and encoding/decoding functionalities.

classes.name: SBC::Config
classes.description: Configuration parameters for SBC codec, including preset, channel mode, and bitpool.

classes.name: SBC::Format
classes.description: Represents the format specifications for SBC codec, including sampling frequency, channel mode, block length, subbands, and allocation method.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the SBC codec with a stream of bytes or a format object.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Retrieves the current configuration of the SBC codec.

methods.name: QOS
methods.description: Sets the Quality of Service policy for the SBC codec.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes raw audio data into SBC frames.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes SBC frames into raw audio data.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the SBC capabilities or configuration into a byte stream.
